address: 260, Section 1, Wenxing Road, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan
bio: Green wainscotting and seating provide visual continuity with the lush outdoor greenery, while splashes of orange add contrast. The kitchen team, who have experience in Cantonese, Taiwanese, Hakkanese and Sichuanese cooking, craft an eclectic Chinese menu that crosses geographical boundaries. Try their signature sautéed squid in salted egg yolk sauce, shredded beef with yellow chives, or fried crispy duck.
